items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I picked four names: Lionel Hampton to Michael Bolton to Stuff to the Paul Butterfield Band. [INTERVIEWEE] Okay.

ctx.x: Oh great. Yeah I think in that video for my new CD, “Tell Me” the Chris Parker Trio, I talk about Uccello, a Renaissance Italian painter and he sort of, a lot of people think or agree that he kind of invented perspective because he did this painting that’s very realistic but it also has this depth that he accomplishes by there’s a tile floor and there’s lances laying on the floor and there’s a landscape in the background that kind of recedes even further. So yeah.

Well I was — I picked out four names and I was going to print out your discography but I didn’t have enough paper. So I picked four names: Lionel Hampton to Michael Bolton to Stuff to the Paul Butterfield Band.
